# The Flat-Eyed Felionis

A [[The Felionis|Felionis]], Shervinaw's own hunting cat, grown out of the mother roots and plated in bark. This one went into the grey and came back with its bark soft at the edges and its eyes gone perfectly round and flat. It still guards. It guards the root now.

It lands its blows and is hard to catch. Its signature Disrupted is the Felionis's own gift turned on the Fell: a Fell it marks finds their spells fall apart unless they roll a Fellmark. Its hole is its Power of 0. It hits light, and its danger is that it keeps the Fell off the stone. It goes for whoever is setting stone. If a Fell at the table has a Felionis of their own, it goes for someone else first, as the scene says.

## What it wants

To guard. A Felionis guards the new shoots of the forest the way a dog guards a yard. This one went into the grey and came back guarding the root. It is not hungry and not cruel. It goes for whatever threatens what it guards, and tonight that is whoever is setting stone.

## Getting past it without a fight

A Fell can reach the old guard under the grey with Rootsummons, or a Fell with a Felionis can set their own cat in front of it. Either turns it out of the fight. [[06 - The Grey Mother|The Grey Mother]] writes out both.
